data.text: Hi, yeah, so my internet has been really slow for the last couple of days and I'm not sure what's going on. I'm hoping you guys can help me figure it out.
I'll help you get to the bottom of this. Let me start by pulling up your account and running some quick diagnostics on your connection.

data.note: Signal level outside acceptable range; frequent restarts indicate line issue.
High latency and packet loss detected — possible signal or line issue.

results.title: Slow Internet Speeds Troubleshooting
results.snippet: 1. **Weak modem signal** — downstream signal below -7 dBmV or above +7 dBmV indicates line issues. 2. **WiFi interference or distance** — 2.4 GHz band congestion; customer too far from router. 3. **Peak-hour congestion** — shared neighbourhood node oversubscribed in the evenings (6–10 PM).

results.title: Modem Reboot Procedure
results.snippet: Reboot the modem when the customer reports: - No internet connection despite modem appearing powered on - Very slow speeds that did not improve after router restart

results.title: Device Compatibility — Approved Modems and Routers
results.snippet: Customers must use a modem on the ISP-approved list to receive full technical support. Unapproved modems may work but are not guaranteed to provision correctly or receive remote management commands (including `reboot_modem_remotely`).

<analysis>
I've gathered the following diagnostic evidence:

**Account & Equipment** [tool:lookup_customer]: Jane Smith, active account since 2021, Gigabit 500 service tier, NETGEAR CM500 modem (ISP-approved [kb:device_compatibility]), TP-Link Archer AX21 router, located in northeast (ZIP 10001).

**Modem Status** [tool:check_modem_status]: The modem is online but showing critical issues:
- Downstream signal at -12 dBmV (outside acceptable range; should be between -7 and +7 dBmV per [kb:slow_speeds])
- Upstream signal at 44 dBmV (acceptable)
- **7 restarts in the last 24 hours** — indicates line instability
- Uptime only 0.5 hours (modem just restarted)
- Signal quality marked as "weak"

**Connectivity Test** [tool:ping_customer_modem]: High latency (287 ms) and 12.5% packet loss detected — consistent with signal degradation.

**ISP Outage Check** [tool:check_isp_outage]: No active outages in the customer's area.

**Diagnostic Conclusion**: This is a **line-level signal issue**, not a widespread outage or WiFi problem. The weak downstream signal and frequent restarts strongly suggest a problem with the cable line between the ISP's network and the customer's modem. This is a hardware/infrastructure issue that requires ISP field technician intervention.

**Next Step**: Escalate to field service for line inspection and signal conditioning.
</analysis>
